backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata file listing features, related source files, components, tests, and confidence for two UI improvements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of each frontend source file.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variables and global styles defining color tokens, dark mode values, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template mounting the React app at #root and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app assembling all sections, navigation, footer, smooth scrolling, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ReferenceNotes.t: Collapsible reference notes section with images, using Card and Collapsible components.
frontend/src/components/SectionNav.tsx: Sticky top navigation with scroll-based active highlighting, smooth section navigation, and responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutMe: About Me section showing strengths, core expertise, and styled cards with icons and badges.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroExe: Hero section with headline, pitch text, CTA buttons, key stats, and a scroll indicator.
frontend/src/components/sections/ImpactS: Displays before/after impact cards from impactStatements and supporting summary stats.
frontend/src/components/sections/Reviews: Shows a LinkedIn reviews card with link, copy-to-clipboard functionality, and section header.
frontend/src/components/sections/Roadmap: Renders a three‑phase 90‑day roadmap with phase cards and core principles list.
frontend/src/components/sections/Success: Provides tabbed success criteria content with navigation to impact and roadmap sections.
frontend/src/content/pitchContent.ts: Contains structured STAR-format success‑criteria stories grouped into data, governance, and bottleneck categories for frontend display.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity and invalidates queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, stored identity restoration, and login state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend query methods exist.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode styles, and UI component styles for tabs and navigation.
frontend/src/lib/scroll.ts: Utility function for smooth scrolling to sections with a fixed offset.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, and Internet Identity provider before rendering the application.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling plugins, custom colors, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, known issues, and implemented features for the interview‑narrative website.
